name: govuk-frontend-example-ruby
description: GOV.UK Frontend example using Ruby, Rails, and ViewComponent with official fixture HTML parity.

scripts.start: npm run build:styles && ./scripts/with-ruby.sh bundle exec rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p ${PORT:-3000}
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:ruby
scripts.verify:docs: npm run format:check && npm run lint:md
scripts.verify: npm run verify:docs && npm run build:styles && npm run lint:ruby && npm test
